pages.lesson:
LESSON: KUSOMA 7.2.1 KUSOMA KWA MAPANA MATINI

Grade: Grade 4
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: MATUNDA NA MIMEA Mada Mada Ndogo Matokeo Maalum Yanayotarajiwa Shughuli za Ujifu
Topic 7.2: Kusoma 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Kusoma 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua matini ya aina mbalimbali ya kusoma na kuchagua yanayomvutia
2. kusoma matini aliyochagua ili kufaidi ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua matini ya aina mbalimbali ya kusoma na kuchagua yanayomvutia
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua matini ya aina mbalimbali ya kusoma na kuchagua yanayomvutia. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kusoma matini aliyochagua ili kufaidi ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa
   In simple words: practise until you can kusoma matini aliyochagua ili kufaidi ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Kusoma 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Kusoma 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini in the examples.
2. Explain Kusoma 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Kusoma 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini.
4. Show that you can: kutambua matini ya aina mbalimbali ya kusoma na kuchagua yanayomvutia

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Kusoma 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Kusoma 7.2.1 Kusoma kwa Mapana Matini important for a Grade 4 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua matini ya aina mbalimbali ya kusoma na kuchagua yanayomvutia
2. kusoma matini aliyochagua ili kufaidi ujumbe na lugha iliyotumiwa

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
